name: dtls-dtls-1-2-extension-semantic-normalization
instr:
Pion DTLS cannot analyze DTLS 1.2 legacy extensions for lost information or invalid input without changing their wire behavior. Add semantic normalization, compatibility and strict modes, and stable connection reports.

Keep SupportedPointFormats, ExtendedMasterSecret, and RenegotiationInfo codec results unchanged while producing canonical, idempotent interpretations. ExtensionSemanticStatus defines SemanticRetained, SemanticDiscarded, then SemanticRejected. Compatibility accepts every currently decodable payload; strict rejects lossy or invalid semantics; compatibility remains the default. NormalizationMode defines NormalizationCompatibility then NormalizationStrict. ExtensionSemanticReport contains Type, Status, and CanonicalData.

Normalize every assigned extension emitted or received before successful use. ExtensionNormalizationError identifies Type and Cause. Reports distinguish ExtensionNormalizationLocal from ExtensionNormalizationPeer. ExtensionNormalizationReport contains Entries; each ExtensionNormalizationEntry contains Type, Direction, Status, and independently owned CanonicalData.

Deduplicate unchanged input in processing order. Append changed retry input after unchanged decisions. Copied established state and resumed state preserve the selected mode and completed report as independent immutable state without duplicating decisions. Later processing appends only genuinely new input. Conn.Read and Conn.Write still initiate negotiation, with strict rejection before
